claims.sentence: The purpose of the electronic portfolio is to record and store information about significant results of the student's professional and personal development
University students independently fill out the following portfolio sections
Мои работы и рецензии (My works and reviews) allows students to present information about any works completed during or outside their studies by filling in specific fields

The required fields are Название (Title), which specifies the work's name; Тип (Type), which specifies the work type such as practice, research work, project, or other work; Описание (Description), which provides a brief description of the work or research; and Файл (File), which attaches materials, articles, or research documents
The second section allows the evaluation of any participant in the educational relationship's work by searching for the work using the participant's email address
Достижения (Achievements) allows students to provide information about their achievements in academic, research, socially significant, cultural-creative, and sports activities
The evidence does not specify deadlines for completing the sections
The evidence does not state limits on the number of works or file sizes
The evidence does not explain how the email search function operates or who can perform the evaluation
The evidence does not list any other portfolio sections beyond the three mentioned
The evidence does not specify consequences for empty or incomplete fields
The evidence does not address how achievements are verified or approved
